title: Node Finder

targets.expr: count(puppet_node_os{node=~".*${search}.*",name=~"${os}",environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"} == 1 unless on(node, alias) (puppet_node_trusted{environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"} unless puppet_node_trusted{role=~"${role}",datacenter=~"${datacenter}",environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) unless on(node, alias) (puppet_version{environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"} unless puppet_version{version=~"${agent_version}",environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) unless on(node) ((max by (node) (puppet_cis_compliance_score{score_type="base",environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) or max by (node) (puppet_node_os{environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) * 0 + 101) >= ${cis}) unless on(node) ((sum by (node) (puppet_patching_data{type="all",environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) or max by (node) (puppet_node_os{environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) * 0 - 1) <= ${patch})) or (vector(0) and on() (count(puppet_status{environment=~"${environment}",alias=~"${pe}",job=~"${pdctng_job}"}) > 0))

panels.description: The nodes the filters describe, at most 500 of them; Matched above is the true count. The node name links through to that node's board. CIS score and patch debt are joined on per row, restricted to this filtered set: a blank cell is a node with no scan or no patch data, not a zero. Role and agent version stay filters rather than columns, because they are search facets, not the act-on-it numbers CIS and patching are. A node missing the fact behind a filter is kept, not hidden: a filter only excludes a node whose facts say it does not match.

description: Turn a description of nodes into a named set: filter by name, OS, role, location, agent version, and now compliance (CIS below 80) and patch state (patchable). What is wrong with them is PDCTNG Triage; this is the whole fleet.
